_comment: PHASE FIVE-K.1 -- the FIVE-K.0B §48-49-identified small catalog addition (FIVE_K_VO2_INTERVAL_DEVELOPMENT stage, PD-FIVEK-08a). A genuine semantic audit of the existing catalog (fartlek.v6.json, threshold-tempo.v5.json, goal-pace-ten-k.v3.json, hm-pace.v1.json) found no existing workout satisfying this stage's frozen contract: FARTLEK is unstructured continuous SURGE_AND_FLOAT (no discrete work/recovery interval structure, no VO2-specific intensity semantic); THRESHOLD_TEMPO is continuous sub-maximal tempo, not VO2max-intensity; neither has a dedicated interval-then-recovery component pair. This workout directly encodes FIVE-K.0B's own frozen stage semantics only (role=VO2max/aerobic-ceiling development, Build->RaceSpecific boundary placement, interval+recovery structure) -- no interval count, repetition distance, rest duration, or pace-zone number is invented here: this catalog layer (like every existing workout definition in this repository) carries only component/intensity STRUCTURE, never prescribed numeric doses -- those remain CatalogSessionPrescriptionPlanner's existing effort-only prescription path (EffortFor/PaceFor), identical in kind to how FARTLEK/THRESHOLD_TEMPO are already prescribed today (no numeric pace producer exists for either, and none is added here).
